import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0]) * 2
    dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for __ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(n):
        for h in range(i + 2):  # h from 0 to i+1 inclusive
            ci = i + 1
            if (ci - h) % 2 != 0:
                continue
            if h + 1 <= i:
                dp[ci][h][0] = (dp[i][h + 1][1] + 1) % MOD
                dp[ci][h][1] = dp[i][h + 1][0]
                if h > 0:
                    dp[ci][h][0] = (dp[ci][h][0] + dp[i][h - 1][0]) % MOD
                    dp[ci][h][1] = (dp[ci][h][1] + dp[i][h - 1][0]) % MOD
            else:
                dp[ci][h][0] = (dp[i][h - 1][1] + 1) % MOD
                dp[ci][h][1] = dp[i][h - 1][0]
    print(dp[n][0][0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
